policy.displayName: Payment not applied to its order

documentation.content:
Stripe charged a customer, but the webhook could not complete the order: the order wasn't PAYMENT_PENDING, the PaymentIntent wasn't its own, or the amount didn't match (see `reason`). Refund or fix the order by hand.

What to do: [Runbook](https://roberto-bustos-hernandez.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ARQ/pages/24772610#Investigar-un-error).
